collectedBy: Claude session 12 from web search result snippets (Wowhead item URLs and titles, warcraft.wiki.gg token and tier-piece pages, raid loot guides). Direct page fetches needed approval nobody answered, so every ID comes from a search-result URL.
summary: Tokens are shared by armor type, like Season 1. Prefix = armor group (Venomwoven cloth, Venomcured leather, Venomcast mail, Venomforged plate); suffix = slot (Idol hands, Effigy head, Relic legs, Remnant shoulders, Icon chest). Each opens into a soulbound tier piece for the player's class. The omni-token is exchanged at Kirana (next to the Catalyst in Silvermoon) for any one Season 2 tier piece.

conflicts: Evoker hands vs head: SETTLED in session 13. The names sound swapped but the item tooltips (warcraft.wiki.gg item pages) say Calamitous Echo's Magmashapers = Mail Head (from Venomcast Effigy) and Calamitous Echo's Ebon Greathorns = Mail Hands (from Venomcast Idol). The item numbers agree: 271501 Magmashapers sits in the head position and 271502 Greathorns in the hands position of the evoker block. Sources: https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Calamitous_Echo's_Magmashapers, https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Calamitous_Echo's_Ebon_Greathorns.

Boss names: wow.gg calls two bosses 'Entombed Wardens' and 'The Lost Expedition'; the wiki, Wowhead guides and most loot tables say 'Entombed Sentinels' and 'The Lost Explorers'. We follow the majority.

Database 'looted from' fields name encounter NPCs (wowdb: Breath of Ula'tek for Venomwoven Idol; Wowhead PTR: Mor'zahi for Venomcast Remnant, Vexhul for Venomcast Effigy, Shrouded Venom for Venomcast Icon). These look like PTR/encounter-unit names, not the boss that drops the token; we follow the loot guides.
Wowhead lists item level 219 on the base token items; difficulty versions (282/295/308/321 for hands, 285/298/311/324 for others) are probably the same item ID with bonus IDs, not confirmed.
method.gg calls the curio vendor 'Ki'rula'; the curio's own tooltip, wiki, Icy Veins and Wowhead say Kirana in Silvermoon. We follow Kirana.
stillMissing: Nothing to collect: 20/20 tokens, 65/65 reward names and IDs, each with its source.

Independent check by the research team (task C4b) before anything goes into ItemDB. Weakest links: the 52 IDs read only from MythicDrake item URLs (one source each); the numbering pattern below agrees with every one of them.
howToFinish: Same search trick as Season 1: WebSearch '"<piece name>" wowhead item' for Wowhead item URLs, or u.gg gear pages for static.bigbrain.gg/wow/item/assets/NNN.webp next to the piece name. For blank names, search the wiki's tier-piece pages ('tier 36 set for <class>').
In game, /ll debug tokenexport records direct token observations; stage with tools/import_token_research.py.
Then an independent check (C4b) before anything goes into database/records.lua.
idPattern: Observed, not used as data: tokens are 270910-270929 in blocks of 4 per slot (woven, cured, cast, forged): hands/Idol 270910-13, head/Effigy 270914-17, legs/Relic 270918-21, shoulders/Remnant 270922-25, chest/Icon 270926-29; curio 270909 just before. All 20 were confirmed one by one from Wowhead URLs; none rely on the pattern.
rewardIDPattern: Observed, not used as data: tier pieces are 271451-271567 in blocks of 9 per class (cloak, wrist, waist, shoulder, legs, head, hands, feet, chest), class order Warrior, Paladin, Death Knight, Shaman, Hunter, Evoker, Rogue, Monk, Druid, Demon Hunter, Warlock, Priest, Mage. Same layout as Season 1. All 65 IDs were read from pages next to their names; every one also fits this pattern.
